purpose: Execute a real frozen-model A0 -> B1 -> A2 software-continuity reproduction after experiment 001 was blocked by unrecoverable historical seed-byte provenance and the separately requested Model-B revision 816ebadd0c024779e6657fdcfc1ab02bb9a7c473 was proven unavailable.
claim_boundary: This experiment measures computational substrate continuity across frozen model replacement. It does not establish consciousness, sentience, personhood, biological life, resurrection, a soul, deceased-person identity, quantum advantage, or a new physical effect.

model_b.label: historical reproduction pin; not a substitute for the unavailable requested 816ebadd revision

controls.a_only_schedule: A0 -> A1 -> A2 using the same frozen Model A and two deterministic state handoffs
controls.empty_memory: zero-record personal-memory substrate with real Model-A inference
controls.shuffled_memory: separate verified substrate with deterministic 17 <-> 311 retrieval rotation and real Model-A inference

measurements.metric: paired continuation conditional NLL; delta = rejected normalized NLL minus preferred normalized NLL
measurements.threshold_policy: descriptive only; no post-hoc behavioral success threshold
